name: Scarlet Macaw
description: Macaws have striped faces, like facial makeup in Peking Opera. They turn red when they are excited. Their feathers are colorful and eye-catching, and have high ornamental value. It is smart, can talk and sing, and is loved by the public. Many people even keep it as a pet. Parrots, homophonic to "heroic", have the meaning of vitality and prosperity; in pairs, they also imply love, happiness and family harmony; because of their long lifespan, they also symbolize longevity and health. Parrots, full of auspiciousness, are often made into ornaments to decorate homes.
